image_description: A small, young wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting on a large, flat, white circular object that resembles a tortilla or flatbread. The rabbit has brownish-grey fur with some darker speckling, characteristic of a cottontail. It is facing left, with its ears laid back slightly. One foreleg is visible, tucked under the chest. The hind legs are mostly obscured by the body's rounded posture. The background shows a glimpse of grey pavement or concrete.
